problem: Acquisition-first has delivered zero additions since v8019.
root_cause: Next source requires pinned text extraction and per-record rights and dedup gates.
desired_outcome: Material normalized Wikibooks cohort; production search only if all existing gates are earned.
expected_value: More usable searchable recipes; prepared rows alone are not product delivery.

options.description: Reuse F2 discovery and implement conservative pinned-text extraction with cached evidence.
options.pros: Reuses provenance and source contracts, no paid service.
options.cons: Unsupported wikitext and ambiguous rights remain held.

options.description: Manually author every recipe into the old public seed schema.
options.cons: Low throughput, recommendation metadata would delay search.

architecture: Offline acquisition bundle, separate CC-BY-SA recipe text, no runtime fetch; reuse protected incremental storage only after prewrite.
tradeoffs: Conservative parse and rights holds reduce yield but preserve source fidelity. Discovery count is not recipe delivery.
estimated_cost: 0 EUR; sequential cached free API reads and ordinary required CI only.

decisions.decision: Acquire exact revision source and talk snapshots and fail closed on unsupported expression or notices.
decisions.rationale: Existing rights contract requires page-specific provenance.
decisions.expected_consequences: Recoverable cache and explicit held records.

decisions.decision: Compare with complete pinned v8019 before novelty and prewrite; do not infer global semantic novelty from title absence.
decisions.rationale: Owner requires full baseline and meaningful variants.
decisions.expected_consequences: Unresolved comparisons stay held and production authority is not assumed.

acceptance_criteria: C1 Complete revision-pinned acquisition or precise access failure with cache.
C2 Source-faithful structural extraction and per-record rights states.
C3 Full baseline comparison and conservative unresolved semantic states.
C4 Required deterministic validation and honest product/write terminal state.
risks: Transclusions and extra source notices need explicit holds.
Production requires separately earned admission/write gates.

roadmap_alignment.milestone_line: | V1.x / Corpus breadth | **P0 ACQUISITION-FIRST / MAXIMIZE RIGHTS-CLEAN CORPUS** | Acquire and ingest every lawfully reusable, provenance-preserving, structurally usable recipe cohort that fits the protected zero-cost runtime. Search/open usability is the product gate; recommendation/nutrition/classification completeness must not block corpus growth. |
roadmap_alignment.priority_rationale: Wikibooks selected as next eligible source; other research lanes preserved.
roadmap_alignment.goal_contribution: Prepare usable additions and advance to real search only with earned gates.
roadmap_alignment.value_signal: Net new recipes actually searchable/openable; baseline 22086.
